text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Killers of Sheikh Nizar al-Halabi to be executed by hanging in Roumieh jail before dawn amid tight security measures.

-During the Islamic summit in Islamabad, Prime Minister Hariri met with Iranian President Rafsanjani. Lebanon proposed to the summit the immediate suspension of the process of normalising relations between the Islamic states and Israel.
-Parliament Speaker Berri begins his official trip to France and meets President Chirac today. Deterioration in the regional situation has started to reflect negatively on Lebanon, he said.
-Acting Finance Minister Siniora back from Germany. He said: We are preparing to issue mark-denominated treasury bills in the German financial market.
-Syrian Vice President Khaddam and Prime Minister Hariri demanded the Islamic summit to ban dealings with Israel.
-Foreign Minister Bouez warns against the dangers of Israeli settlement programs.
-A pro-Israeli militiaman was killed in a bomb blast in south Lebanon.
